lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the branchial region. Centroids are arranged in roughly vertical columns, with a prominent set of three larger blobs positioned immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, followed by a series of approximately five visible columns extending towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a lattice-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to dark (ventral) along its longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin shows a sparse arrangement of high-luminance blobs, with approximately four distinct clusters visible against the darker fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of smaller, high-luminance spots, particularly along the anterior margin and proximal base, which are significantly smaller in diameter than the primary flank blobs.
